Cowfusion#001.src: A Human, eh? All the way out 'ere at the end of the canyon? Yer a tough one.
Cowfusion#001.dst: 인간이구먼? 협곡 끝 여기까지 왔다고? 제법 독한 놈이네.
Cowfusion#001.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#002.src: Perhaps I can give yer some work, if yer are lookin' for it? Someone's been coming and nabbing my cows!
Cowfusion#002.dst: 일거리 찾고 있으면 줄 게 있는데? 누가 자꾸 와서 내 소를 훔쳐 가!
Cowfusion#002.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#003.src: 'an I know exactly who it is - that blasted cow scientist that lives in the lab just north of 'ere.
Cowfusion#003.dst: 누군지도 딱 알아. 바로 북쪽 실험실에 사는 그 망할 소 과학자 놈이야.
Cowfusion#003.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#004.src: Anyway, yer up for the job? Can't let 'im just keep stealing them forever!
Cowfusion#004.dst: 그래서, 할 거야? 그놈이 계속 훔쳐 가게 둘 순 없잖아!
Cowfusion#004.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#005.src: His cavern laboratory is just north from 'ere. Not too hard to find. Once yer there, get him to return my cows!
Cowfusion#005.dst: 그놈 동굴 실험실은 바로 북쪽이야. 찾기 어렵지 않아. 가서 내 소 돌려놓으라고 해!
Cowfusion#005.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#006.src: There's one problem though. The door to the place is always shut, so you'll 'ave to find another way in.
Cowfusion#006.dst: 근데 문제가 하나 있어. 거기 문은 늘 닫혀 있으니까, 다른 길로 들어가야 할 거야.
Cowfusion#006.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#008.src: Find a way into the Laboratory

Cowfusion#009.src: Search the Laboratory for the missing cows

Cowfusion#010.src: Find a way to free the Cows.

Cowfusion#014.dst: 이게 뭐야? 믿을 수가 없네, 너냐? 우리 아가, 돌아올 줄 알았다!
Cowfusion#014.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#015.dst: 도시 사는 인간을 고용해서 널 찾아오려고 했다니? 하!
Cowfusion#015.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#021.src: You're right, there is no password. Just seeing if you can understand me.
Cowfusion#021.dst: 맞아, 암호 같은 건 없어. 내 말을 알아듣나 본 거야.
Cowfusion#021.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#022.src: You're one of us then, the oppressed? Want to break free from these farmers? Well aren't you in luck.
Cowfusion#022.dst: 그럼 너도 억압받는 우리 편이구나? 농부들한테서 벗어나고 싶어? 운이 좋네.
Cowfusion#022.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#023.src: I can help you with that. WE can help you with that.
Cowfusion#023.dst: 내가 도와줄 수 있어. '우리'가 도와줄 수 있지.
Cowfusion#023.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#024.src: Our people have a secret hideout not far from here. It's located right under that barn just behind me.
Cowfusion#024.dst: 우리 동족의 비밀 은신처가 가까이 있어. 바로 내 뒤 헛간 아래야.
Cowfusion#024.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#025.src: It may seem close, but unless you've been practicing your atheletics, you won't be able to get over these fences.
Cowfusion#025.dst: 가까워 보여도, 운동 좀 하지 않았으면 이 울타리는 못 넘어.
Cowfusion#025.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#026.src: See that haybale in the middle of our pen? I bet you could push and pull it into such a position that'd allow you to climb over the fence with your cow physique.
Cowfusion#026.dst: 우리 한가운데 건초 더미 보이지? 그걸 밀고 당겨서 잘 옮기면 소 몸으로도 울타리를 넘을 수 있을걸.
Cowfusion#026.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#027.src: The second pen might have a similar problem, but I'm sure you can figure that out yourself.
Cowfusion#027.dst: 두 번째 우리도 비슷할 텐데, 그건 네가 알아서 풀 수 있을 거야.
Cowfusion#027.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#031.src: What? What does that even mean? There isn't actually a password! Or did no one tell me that there was? Ah, nevermind, at least you can understand me.
Cowfusion#031.dst: 뭐? 그게 무슨 소리야? 암호는 진짜 없다니까! 아니면 나만 몰랐나? 아, 됐어. 적어도 말은 통하네.
Cowfusion#031.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#039.src: Find and enter the Secret Cow Hideout

Cowfusion#041.src: Oh, a new recruit? We weren't expecting anyone at this time. How'd you find your way in?
Cowfusion#041.dst: 어, 신입이에요? 이 시간엔 올 사람이 없는데. 어떻게 들어왔어요?
Cowfusion#041.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#042.src: Wait, you're different. Something's off about you. Like you've never been in a cow's body before.
Cowfusion#042.dst: 잠깐, 당신 좀 달라요. 뭔가 이상해요. 소 몸에 처음 들어온 것처럼요.
Cowfusion#042.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#043.src: Oh. Oh, this is not good. Uhm, you should talk to the boss. He'll probably know what to do with you.
Cowfusion#043.dst: 아. 아, 이거 큰일이네. 음, 대장님께 가 보세요. 어떻게 할지 아실 거예요.
Cowfusion#043.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#044.src: You'll find him in the big office at the very end of this facility. Just stick to the path and don't be nosey, okay?
Cowfusion#044.dst: 이 시설 맨 끝 큰 사무실에 계세요. 길만 따라가고 기웃거리지 마세요, 알겠죠?
Cowfusion#044.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#045.src: Find the one who's in charge of the hideout

Cowfusion#047.src: Whoop, alright! Don't want you going anywhere, buddy! Uh... What are you doing here, exactly...?
Cowfusion#047.dst: 워워, 좋아! 어디 가면 안 돼, 친구! 어... 여기서 뭐 하는 거야, 대체...?
Cowfusion#047.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#048.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#048.dst: 너- 뭐? 세상에, 그게 어떻게 가능해? 그럴 만한 게 없었는데...
Cowfusion#048.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#049.src: Oh! You must've been snooping through my laboratory. That's... okay, we can talk about that later. Did you step into my machine?
Cowfusion#049.dst: 아! 내 실험실을 뒤지고 다녔구나. 그건... 괜찮아, 나중에 얘기하자. 혹시 내 기계에 들어갔어?
Cowfusion#049.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#050.src: It's not even meant to do that! Its purpose is to turn the exiles back into Wocs. So how does a Human become a cow...?
Cowfusion#050.dst: 그런 용도가 아닌데! 추방자들을 Woc으로 되돌리는 기계야. 근데 인간이 어떻게 소가 돼...?
Cowfusion#050.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#051.src: Right, right, sorry. Here, uh- I'll try and get this cage down. Darn controls... Why did I design these so poorly?
Cowfusion#051.dst: 그래, 그래, 미안. 자, 어- 이 우리 내려 볼게. 망할 조작판... 왜 이렇게 엉망으로 만들었지?
Cowfusion#051.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#052.src: ...So while I try to figure out which lever to push, tell me about yourself! Anything interesting going on in your life?
Cowfusion#052.dst: ...어느 레버를 당길지 찾는 동안 네 얘기 좀 해 줘! 요즘 재밌는 일 있었어?
Cowfusion#052.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#053.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!
Cowfusion#053.dst: 너... 너였어? 너구나! 와, 다시 만나서 정말 반가워! Wynn에서 같이 사고 친 게 언제 적이야!
Cowfusion#053.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#054.src: This is great, actually! I- I can show you around this place! Introduce you to some of the folks we freed together! Oh, what fantastic timing this has been.
Cowfusion#054.dst: 오히려 잘됐다! 내- 내가 여기 구경시켜 줄게! 우리가 같이 구한 사람들도 소개해 주고! 와, 타이밍 끝내주네.
Cowfusion#054.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#055.src: I just need to figure out which switch to pull... I think it's this one! Probably. I really need to label these things. Alright, here goes!
Cowfusion#055.dst: 어느 스위치를 당길지만 알아내면... 이거 같아! 아마도. 이것들 이름표 좀 붙여야겠어. 좋아, 간다!
Cowfusion#055.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#057.src: I, uh... Hah. Very funny. Tell me you're a human, then pretend to be a cow.
Cowfusion#057.dst: 난, 어... 하. 참 웃기네. 인간이라더니 소 흉내를 내?
Cowfusion#057.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#058.src: That's... fine. You know, I'm under quite a lot of stress right now. Working hard, day in and day out. I don't really need your attitude right now!
Cowfusion#058.dst: 그건... 괜찮아. 있잖아, 나 요즘 스트레스가 엄청나. 밤낮없이 일만 하고. 지금 네 그런 태도 필요 없거든!
Cowfusion#058.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#059.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.
Cowfusion#059.dst: 있잖아? 이런 태도 필요 없어. 너- 너 구덩이로 보내 버릴 거야. 내- 내 다른 실패작들이 있는 곳으로.
Cowfusion#059.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#060.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#060.dst: ...무기 있잖아. 어떻게든 되겠지! 나한테 받을 거 없어! 자, 아래가 마음에 드는지 봐!
Cowfusion#060.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#062.src: Okay. So you are just a regular cow. Not a Woc. Uh... Who let you in, little pal? I'm going to need to have to have a word about closing the doors...
Cowfusion#062.dst: 좋아. 그냥 평범한 소구나. Woc이 아니고. 어... 누가 들여보냈니, 꼬마야? 문 닫는 거 얘기 좀 해야겠네...
Cowfusion#062.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#063.src: Well, this is... awkward. So, then... cow. What's it like being... a cow?
Cowfusion#063.dst: 음, 이거... 어색하네. 그럼... 소야. 소로 사는 건... 어때?

Cowfusion#076.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#078.src: Right. Okay. Figure I'd best let you go free.
Cowfusion#078.dst: 그래. 좋아. 그냥 풀어 주는 게 낫겠다.
Cowfusion#078.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#079.src: ...Unless. Unless. Nobody's... nobody's looking. I could just send you to The Pit... Nobody would know.
Cowfusion#079.dst: ...아니면. 아니면. 아무도... 아무도 안 보잖아. 그냥 구덩이로 보내도... 아무도 모를 거야.
Cowfusion#079.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#080.src: It's... easier this way. It's fine. Maybe you'll even- maybe you'll even make your way out. Good luck, little buddy.
Cowfusion#080.dst: 이게... 편하니까. 괜찮아. 어쩌면- 어쩌면 알아서 나올지도 몰라. 행운을 빌어, 꼬마야.
Cowfusion#080.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#083.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#083.dst: 소각로에 떨어졌다고? 그리고 변이 소 괴물을 쓰러뜨렸어?
Cowfusion#083.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#084.src: ...Oh! You're the one Drale told us to look out for. Accidentally dropped into the Pit, huh?
Cowfusion#084.dst: ...아! Drale이 잘 찾아보라던 게 너구나. 실수로 구덩이에 떨어졌다며?
Cowfusion#084.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#085.src: The boss said to apologize to ya for the inconvenience. We've all been workin' late hours recently... Some of us more than others.
Cowfusion#085.dst: 대장이 불편을 끼쳐서 미안하다고 전하래. 요즘 다들 늦게까지 일하거든... 누구는 더 심하고.
Cowfusion#085.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#086.src: Anyhow, follow me. I'll take you back to him, and you can talk this out! You'll be back as a human in no time.
Cowfusion#086.dst: 아무튼 따라와. 대장한테 데려다줄 테니 얘기로 풀어! 금방 인간으로 돌아갈 거야.
Cowfusion#086.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#087.src: So... yeah. That's Drale for you. Absentminded as ever. He said something about labeling his levers from now on, so I reckon that's a positive.
Cowfusion#087.dst: 그러니까... 뭐. Drale이 원래 저래. 늘 정신이 없지. 앞으로 레버에 이름표를 붙인다니 다행이지 뭐.
Cowfusion#087.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#088.src: ...You're a good friend of the boss, right? Would you be able to put in a good word for us? Gerald and I have been down here for a while, and we'd like to get back to our normal positions.
Cowfusion#088.dst: ...대장이랑 친한 친구지? 우리 얘기 좀 잘 해 줄 수 있어? 나랑 Gerald가 여기 꽤 오래 있었는데, 원래 자리로 돌아가고 싶거든.
Cowfusion#088.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#089.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#089.dst: Drale도 기분 좋은 날엔 괜찮은데, 요즘 그런 날이 거의 없어! 계속 그... 전혀 쓸데없는 일로 밤을 새워!
Cowfusion#089.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#166.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#168.src: Well, alright. Let's just- get you in my machine, I guess. It worked for the exiles, so maybe it will work for you...?
Cowfusion#168.dst: 뭐, 좋아. 일단- 내 기계에 넣어 보자. 추방자들한텐 됐으니까, 너한테도 되지 않을까...?
Cowfusion#168.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#169.src: ...Don't look at me like that. Come on, let's get going.
Cowfusion#169.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#170.src: So... How have you been? It's been a while since our adventure at {p}, hasn't it?
Cowfusion#170.dst: 그래서... 어떻게 지냈어? {p}에서 같이 모험한 지 꽤 됐지?
Cowfusion#170.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#171.src: Well, you've been turned into a cow... Obviously... But besides that!
Cowfusion#171.dst: 뭐, 소가 됐지... 당연히... 그거 말고!
Cowfusion#171.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#172.src: Me? Well... heh. I've been doing pretty well, all thing considered. We've been gathering exiles from all over the province! Set up a city for us all while we work towards...
Cowfusion#172.dst: 나? 음... 헤헤. 이것저것 따지면 꽤 잘 지냈어. 지방 곳곳에서 추방자들을 모았거든! 다 같이 살 도시도 세웠고, 목표를 향해...
Cowfusion#172.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#173.src: It's a long story. I can't tell you everything- not yet. But... All of us here, we don't belong here. We just want to go home.
Cowfusion#173.dst: 얘기가 길어. 전부 말해 줄 순 없어- 아직은. 하지만... 여기 있는 우리 모두, 여기 사람이 아니야. 그냥 집에 가고 싶을 뿐이야.
Cowfusion#173.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#174.src: And- and maybe if we can find our ship again, we'll be able to prove that we're not irredeemable. That whatever we went through- that it won't define us.
Cowfusion#174.dst: 그리고- 그리고 우리 배를 다시 찾으면, 구제불능이 아니란 걸 증명할 수 있을지도 몰라. 우리가 겪은 일이- 우리를 정의하진 않는다고.
Cowfusion#174.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#175.src: ...Heh. Don't- don't worry about it too much. For now, this place is enough of a safe haven for us. It'll have to be enough until we succeed.
Cowfusion#175.dst: ...헤헤. 너- 너무 걱정하지 마. 지금은 여기가 우리한테 충분한 안식처야. 성공할 때까진 이걸로 버텨야지.
Cowfusion#175.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#176.src: We're so close. I can feel it. Just... Just a little while left to go.
Cowfusion#176.dst: 거의 다 왔어. 느껴져. 조금만... 조금만 더 가면 돼.
Cowfusion#176.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#177.src: Anyway, uh... Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
Cowfusion#177.dst: 아무튼, 어... 여기 엘리베이터야! 타기만 하면 실험실로 올라갈 수 있어.
Cowfusion#177.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#178.src: The- oh. Uh... It's nothing. Nothing to worry about.
Cowfusion#178.dst: 그- 아. 어... 아무것도 아니야. 신경 쓸 거 없어.
Cowfusion#178.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#179.src: It just leads to... maintenance. Yep! Just- just maintenance. Nothing else.
Cowfusion#179.dst: 그냥... 정비 구역으로 가는 문이야. 응! 그냥- 그냥 정비 구역. 다른 건 없어.
Cowfusion#179.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#180.src: Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
Cowfusion#180.dst: 자, 엘리베이터 타! 어차피 들어가려면 열쇠가 필요한데, 난 절대 그런 거 안 갖고 있어!
Cowfusion#180.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#181.src: ...You're worrying me, friend. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
Cowfusion#181.dst: ...걱정되게 왜 그래, 친구. 자, 가자. 엘리베이터 타고, 원래대로 돌려놓자.
Cowfusion#181.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#182.src: So... Have you done anything interesting recently? Besides- getting turned into a cow. Obviously.
Cowfusion#182.dst: 그래서... 요즘 재밌는 일 했어? 소가- 된 거 말고. 당연히.
Cowfusion#182.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#183.src: You're, uh... Probably wondering what this place is. Just a big city under some random guy's farm, right?
Cowfusion#183.dst: 너, 어... 여기가 뭔지 궁금하지? 웬 농장 밑에 큰 도시라니, 그렇지?
Cowfusion#183.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#184.src: It's... heh. We've been trying to gather as many of our people as we can. We exiles have to stick together, after all.
Cowfusion#184.dst: 여긴... 헤헤. 우리 동족을 최대한 모으고 있어. 추방자끼리는 뭉쳐야 하니까.
Cowfusion#184.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#185.src: It's a long story. I'm not sure how much of it I really want to tell you, heh. Especially considering... Yeah.
Cowfusion#185.dst: 얘기가 길어. 얼마나 털어놓고 싶은지 모르겠네, 헤헤. 특히나... 그래.
Cowfusion#185.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#186.src: But. This place is a safe haven for us exiles. A place for us all to live until we achieve our goals.
Cowfusion#186.dst: 그래도. 여긴 우리 추방자들의 안식처야. 목표를 이룰 때까지 다 같이 사는 곳.
Cowfusion#186.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#187.src: And- hey! You've seen our secrets now! May as well let it be a safe haven for you as well, right? Heh.
Cowfusion#187.dst: 그리고- 야! 이제 우리 비밀도 봤잖아! 그럼 너한테도 안식처가 되는 거지, 그렇지? 헤헤.
Cowfusion#187.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#188.src: Oh- the elevator. Here we are. Uh... Just head on in, little buddy? It'll take us up.
Cowfusion#188.dst: 아- 엘리베이터. 다 왔어. 어... 들어가, 꼬마야? 위로 데려다줄 거야.
Cowfusion#188.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#189.src: The- oh. Uh... It's nothing. Nothing to worry about.
Cowfusion#189.dst: 그- 아. 어... 아무것도 아니야. 신경 쓸 거 없어.
Cowfusion#189.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#190.src: It just leads to... maintenance. Yep! Just- just maintenance. Nothing else.
Cowfusion#190.dst: 그냥... 정비 구역으로 가는 문이야. 응! 그냥- 그냥 정비 구역. 다른 건 없어.
Cowfusion#190.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#191.src: Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
Cowfusion#191.dst: 자, 엘리베이터 타! 어차피 들어가려면 열쇠가 필요한데, 난 절대 그런 거 안 갖고 있어!
Cowfusion#191.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#192.src: ...You're worrying me. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
Cowfusion#192.dst: ...걱정되게 왜 그래. 자, 가자. 엘리베이터 타고, 원래대로 돌려놓자.
Cowfusion#192.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#194.src: Uh. Do you- do you understand what I'm saying?
Cowfusion#194.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#195.src: ...This is stupid. I'm talking to a cow. Of course you can't...
Cowfusion#195.dst: ...바보 같네. 소한테 말을 걸다니. 당연히 못 알아듣...
Cowfusion#195.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#197.src: Well I guess I could- talk at you. For a bit. If that's, heh, fine with you!
Cowfusion#197.dst: 뭐, 그냥- 혼잣말하듯 해도 되겠지. 잠깐만. 헤헤, 괜찮다면!
Cowfusion#197.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#198.src: It's been tough, recently. Working towards a goal I know is important, but still feels... out of reach.
Cowfusion#198.dst: 요즘 힘들었어. 중요하다는 걸 아는 목표를 향해 가는데, 여전히... 닿지 않는 느낌이야.
Cowfusion#198.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#199.src: And it doesn't seem like anybody else can see that! That this is important! They look at me like I'm going crazy, and-
Cowfusion#199.dst: 근데 다른 사람들은 그걸 모르는 것 같아! 이게 중요하다는 걸! 날 미친 사람 보듯 보고, 그리고-
Cowfusion#199.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#200.src: I'm not. I know I'm not. We need to find the ship. If we don't, who knows what...
Cowfusion#200.dst: 난 안 미쳤어. 알아. 배를 찾아야 해. 못 찾으면, 무슨 일이...
Cowfusion#200.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#201.src: Anyway! Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
Cowfusion#201.dst: 아무튼! 여기 엘리베이터야! 타기만 하면 실험실로 올라갈 수 있어.
Cowfusion#201.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#202.src: Hrrgh- You're- you're not a cow?! Why would you... I just said all that, and you could...
Cowfusion#202.dst: 흐윽- 너- 너 소가 아니야?! 왜 그랬어... 내가 방금 그 얘길 다 했는데, 다 들었다니...
Cowfusion#202.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#203.src: D-Don't worry about the door. It's... It's nothing. Maintenance. That- that's what it is.
Cowfusion#203.dst: 무- 문은 신경 쓰지 마. 그건... 아무것도 아니야. 정비 구역. 그- 그래, 그거야.
Cowfusion#203.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#204.src: Er... come on, into the elevator! You want to get back to normal, right? Besides, you'd need a key to get in there, and I don't know where you'd find one of those, haha!
Cowfusion#204.dst: 어... 자, 엘리베이터 타! 원래대로 돌아가고 싶잖아? 게다가 거기 들어가려면 열쇠가 필요한데, 어디서 구할지 나도 모르겠다, 하하!
Cowfusion#204.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#205.src: ...Moo. Yep. I agree. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator.
Cowfusion#205.dst: ...음메. 응. 동감이야. 자, 가자. 엘리베이터 타.
Cowfusion#205.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#206.src: So... here we are. The lab!
Cowfusion#206.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#207.src: Just... follow me, for now. The machine is this way.
Cowfusion#207.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#208.src: There it is! If you step into the machine, real quick, it should... it should work!
Cowfusion#208.dst: 저기 있다! 기계에 얼른 들어가면... 될- 될 거야!
Cowfusion#208.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#210.src: Look at you! As good as new!
Cowfusion#210.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#212.src: Heh... Well, there you are! Good as new! I hope...
Cowfusion#212.dst: 헤헤... 자, 됐다! 새것 같네! 아마도...
Cowfusion#212.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#213.src: And- to, uh, compensate you for... you know... Here! One liquid emerald. I feel terrible for how our reunion ended up going... I hope you won't hold it against me?
Cowfusion#213.dst: 그리고- 어, 보상으로... 그러니까... 자! 액체 에메랄드 하나. 재회가 이렇게 돼서 정말 미안해... 나한테 서운해하지 않을 거지?
Cowfusion#213.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#214.src: Uh... I really should get back to work. But- hey! Feel free to visit whenever you want! You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
Cowfusion#214.dst: 어... 이제 일하러 가야 해. 그래도- 야! 언제든 놀러 와! Ranol 농장에 있는 입구를 쓰면 돼.
Cowfusion#214.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#215.src: Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! That'd be nice.
Cowfusion#215.dst: 그땐 내가 요즘 뭘 하는지 더 얘기해 줄게! 좋겠다.
Cowfusion#215.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#216.src: There you are! Back to norm...-
Cowfusion#216.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#217.src: {u}?! What are you- that was you the whole time?! Why didn't you tell me!
Cowfusion#217.dst: {u}?! 너 뭐- 내내 너였어?! 왜 말 안 했어!
Cowfusion#217.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#218.src: Oh gosh, this has been... An awful reunion. I can't believe I dropped you into the Pit...
Cowfusion#218.dst: 세상에, 이건... 최악의 재회야. 내가 널 구덩이에 떨어뜨리다니...
Cowfusion#218.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#219.src: I'm so sorry for- for all of that. You should have told me! Oh...
Cowfusion#219.dst: 그- 그 모든 게 정말 미안해. 말을 했어야지! 아...
Cowfusion#219.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#220.src: Okay, uh... Here, take this. As- as compensation for- for all of that.
Cowfusion#220.dst: 좋아, 어... 자, 이거 받아. 그- 그 모든 것에 대한 보상으로.
Cowfusion#220.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#221.src: I... I need to get back to work. But- uh, if you ever want, feel free to visit sometime? You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
Cowfusion#221.dst: 난... 일하러 가야 해. 그래도- 어, 원하면 언제든 놀러 올래? Ranol 농장에 있는 입구를 쓰면 돼.
Cowfusion#221.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#222.src: Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! Heh...
Cowfusion#222.dst: 그땐 내가 요즘 뭘 하는지 더 얘기해 줄게! 헤헤...
Cowfusion#222.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#000~1.src: Yeah, yeah, I know. But what's it gonna matter if my back's worse than my grandpa's at the end of this?
Cowfusion#000~1.dst: 그래, 그래, 안다고. 근데 이거 다 끝날 때쯤 내 허리가 할아버지보다 나빠지면 무슨 소용이야?
